title: Residency rule engine
description: Datasets are tagged with allowed storage and processing regions, and the rule engine checks every placement decision against the tags. A dataset tagged EU-only is never written to US storage. Rules are evaluated at write time, read time for processing location, and replication time. At ladder rank 1 (foundation), this record covers allowed-region tags per dataset.
demo:
LEVEL = 1
CFG = {1: ("EU", ["EU"]), 2: ("US", ["EU"]), 3: ("EU", ["EU", "US"])}
region, allowed = CFG[LEVEL]
print("store in", region, "| allowed:", allowed, "->", "ALLOW" if region in allowed else "DENY")
provenance: Public harvest — documented archive-engineering practice; method fact-checked against standard references.

title: Cross-border transfer assessment
description: Transfers across borders are assessed against adequacy decisions, safeguards (standard contractual clauses), and derogations. Each transfer records its legal basis. Transfers without a valid basis are blocked before any bytes move. At ladder rank 1 (foundation), this record covers adequacy and safeguard checks.
demo:
LEVEL = 1
CFG = {1: ("EU", "US", "adequacy"), 2: ("EU", "US", None), 3: ("EU", "CH", "adequacy")}
src, dst, basis = CFG[LEVEL]
print("transfer %s -> %s basis: %s" % (src, dst, basis or "NONE"), "->", "ALLOW" if basis else "BLOCK")
provenance: Public harvest — documented archive-engineering practice; method fact-checked against standard references.

title: Data localization enforcement
description: Certain data categories (health, financial, government) must remain within national borders by law. Localization rules pin these categories to in-country storage and processing, and the controller rejects any operation that would move them out. Localization is verified by audit, not assumed. At ladder rank 1 (foundation), this record covers in-country pinning for regulated categories.
provenance: Public harvest — documented archive-engineering practice; method fact-checked against standard references.

title: Region-aware routing
description: Processing requests are routed to regions where the data is allowed to be processed. The router considers data tags, user location, and service availability. Misrouted requests are rejected rather than processed in the wrong region. At ladder rank 1 (foundation), this record covers routing by data tags and user location.
demo:
LEVEL = 1
CFG = {1: (["EU"], "EU"), 2: (["EU"], "US"), 3: (["EU", "US"], "US")}
allowed, user = CFG[LEVEL]
region = user if user in allowed else allowed[0]
print("allowed:", allowed, "| user in", user, "| route to:", region)
provenance: Public harvest — documented archive-engineering practice; method fact-checked against standard references.

title: Residency audit trail
description: Every storage and processing location decision is logged: what data, where, when, under which rule. The audit trail proves compliance to regulators and reveals drift. Trails are retained as long as the data they describe. At ladder rank 1 (foundation), this record covers logging every location decision.
demo:
LEVEL = 1
CFG = {1: 2, 2: 5, 3: 9}
N = CFG[LEVEL]
trail = [{"data": "ds-%d" % i, "region": "EU", "rule": "tag-match"} for i in range(N)]
print("audit entries:", len(trail), "| complete:", all("rule" in e for e in trail))
provenance: Public harvest — documented archive-engineering practice; method fact-checked against standard references.
